_description: Golden output of the OBD-2 reader. Each record is exactly what SerialReader emits downstream for one reading, MINUS the two runtime-stamped fields (timestamp, vehicle_id), which are non-deterministic and excluded from the golden comparison. The test decodes testing/sample_obd_raw_stream.txt through the real reader and asserts the produced records match this file. Also used as the offline replay source for FixtureReader.
_notes: Records 1-9 are Mode 01 PID readings (type=pid); the reader looks up name/unit/formula by PID.
Records 10-12 are Mode 03 fault-code reads (type=dtc); codes=[] means the ECU reported no active faults.
Field shapes: pid records carry {type,pid,name,value,unit}; dtc records carry {type,name,codes}.
